name: Analilia Mejia
role: US representative for New Jersey’s 11th district (since April 2026) and former labor organizer
summary: Mejia advocates universal healthcare, stronger unions, expanded public housing and higher taxes on concentrated wealth. She seeks stronger democratic checks and voting access, an immigration system replacing ICE, climate protections, and equal rights for LGBTQ people and both Israelis and Palestinians.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Demands comprehensive Medicare for All without copayments.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Supports wealth taxes and billionaire minimum taxes.

unions-good.rationale: Credits unions with building the middle class.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Endorses tighter controls on private equity.

strong-leader.rationale: She opposes executive usurpation and calls for restoring democratic institutional checks.

empower-police-military.rationale: She proposes withdrawing ICE’s expanded funding and replacing the agency with a more accountable system.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: She lists the right to marry who you love among 14th Amendment rights to defend and leads a task force to protect them.

abortion-legal.rationale: Defends bodily autonomy and reproductive freedom.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Her signed letter seeks protection for disproportionately burdened Black, Indigenous and other frontline communities.

reduce-immigration.rationale: She opposes removing established law-abiding undocumented residents and proposes pathways to citizenship.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Her signed letter demands stronger climate review and rejects fossil-industry concessions.

democracy-best.rationale: She calls for defending self-government and democratic institutions against democratic backsliding.

accelerate-technology.rationale: Supports pausing new AI data-center construction.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: She explicitly says Israel can be both a Jewish state and democratic.

national-self-determination.rationale: She affirms Israelis’ and Palestinians’ freedom and rights in their homelands.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: She signed opposition to permitting legislation prioritizing fossil-fuel industry expansion.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Her platform says officials trade stocks on inside information and lobbyists out-access constituents, and pledges to stop it.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: She demands accountability for ICE violence and rejects enforcement immunity enabling abuse.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Guarantees equal protection and due process for everyone.

separated-powers.rationale: She objects to the president taking Congress’s spending and war-making powers.

long-naturalization-wait.rationale: She supports citizenship pathways for undocumented people who have built lives in the country.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: She leads the 14th Amendment Task Force defending the citizenship of every child born on US soil against birthright-citizenship attacks.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: She calls for an end to the illegal occupation and annexation of Palestinian territory.

flat-income-tax.rationale: Her platform exempts the first $40,000 of wages from federal tax and sets a 25% minimum for billionaires, a rising rather than flat income-tax design.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: Rejects officials placing themselves above constitutional rules.

ban-cartels.rationale: Promises monopoly breakups and blocking corporate mergers.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: Defends constitutional Fourteenth Amendment protections against authoritarian encroachment.

budget-needs-parliament.rationale: She explicitly defends Congress’s power of the purse against presidential usurpation.

corporate-influence.rationale: Condemns corporate political spending and lobbying dominance.

socialized-care.rationale: Proposes publicly financed childcare for every family.

holocaust-denial.rationale: She co-sponsored the Holocaust Education and Antisemitism Lessons Act and condemns antisemitism, which is incompatible with denying the Holocaust.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Demands transgender equality, healthcare and comprehensive nondiscrimination protections.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: Says billionaire power is undermining democracy.

recognise-genocide.rationale: She has publicly identified the Gaza campaign as genocide and defended that position when challenged.

family-wage.rationale: She says nowhere in the US can a family live on less than $25 an hour and bases her wage bill on that, though she speaks of families rather than a family wage as such.

free-public-college.rationale: Supports tuition-free public study, with four-year income limits.

collective-bargaining.rationale: Supports PRO Act organizing and bargaining protections.

student-debt-relief.rationale: Calls for canceling all student loan debt.

voter-id.rationale: She opposes new documentary voting requirements that exclude eligible voters to address negligible illegal voting.

no-business-privileges.rationale: Seeks ending corporate tax and regulatory favoritism.

notes:
Reviewed labor advocacy from 2018, signed 2022 environmental letter, 2025–26 campaign platform and full March 2026 interview, and April debate. Downloaded platform and interview, searched by all ten themes and checked every remaining null against all 490 statements. Core economic proposals are explicit; no inference from progressive affiliation or Sanders endorsement. Abolish-and-replace ICE is not abolition of police/prisons or open borders: she retains immigration adjudication and criminal screening. Equal LGBTQ protection does not itself document every marriage, military-service or religious-office policy. Court term limits refer to judges, not elected politicians. Institutional investor home-purchase bans are not residence-only ownership rules. Gaza allegations are attributed to her without treating opponents’ antisemitism accusations as her views. Most trade, monetary, religious and detailed military doctrines remain undocumented. No inferred answers.

Merged with an independent claude-sonnet-5-5 audit: 7 answers taken from it, 25 agreed, 0 conflicts settled by the integrator.

claude-sonnet-5-5 notes: Independent second pass from her campaign platform, NJ Spotlight and Democracy Now interviews, 23 House releases and floor/hearing remarks from mejia.house.gov (pages), and her 119th Congress roll calls (Voteview). Nothing is answered from votes alone or from supporters' quotes in the releases. Themes searched: economy, liberty, society, world, government, means, ecology, technology; web searches found no own-words material on guns, drugs, nuclear power, trade, NATO or aid, and her Ukraine and Iran war-powers votes and FISA votes were not turned into answers because the statements go beyond them. Existing first audit read only for its source list; its answers were not copied. Recognise-genocide left null since her Gaza statements are about an ongoing conflict, not formal recognition of past killings.
